moduleSource.revision: track-names branch, Track Names 0.1.3-experimental source (native source sha256 in the manifest's evidence)
moduleSource.note: Working build with GCC 13.2 m68k-linux-gnu, linked with the vendored core-1.0.elemod by elekloader's patch.py.

emulator.name: digikit
emulator.mode: digi-emud --cf-only --no-runtime, firmware-native drawing; framebuffer.get PNG at 4x without interpolation

conditions: Cold boot of the built image on a fresh card, new project. Track names entered only through the panel: SETUP (FUNC + FLTR) > RENAME, UP/DOWN/RIGHT, FUNC + NO and YES. The harness read the name editor's text buffer (read-only) to know when each character was right; it wrote no memory. Names: 1 KICK, 2 SNARE, 3 HAT, 4 CLAP, 5 BASS, 6 LEAD, 7 CHORD, 8 PERC, 9 VOX, 10 FX, 12 RIDE. UI documentation only: not audio, timing or hardware evidence.
keyCodes: digikit panel codes: TRIG 1, FLTR 3, MOD 6, YES 10, UP 11, NO 12, DOWN 14, RIGHT 15, TRK 16, FUNC 17, PTN 23, T1..T16 25..40
